# Growthbook x Bonial - PoC discussion
Date: 2026-11-12 | Duration: 66.55999755859375m

## Summary
The discussion defined a two-week Enterprise Cloud POC focused on successful completion and a forward plan, with self-hosting excluded. Admin access has been provisioned, and a separate staging environment is planned, with a production parent optional. Stefan owns the web SDK and Taron owns the mobile SDK; Swift integration for iOS and Kotlin integration for Android are required, using either the SDK wizard or manual setup. Frontend payload security was reviewed, including plaintext debugging and encrypted variants. Exposure events must include user or session identifiers, experiment data, and variation data. The existing Kraken tracking pipeline will be reused, while GrowthBook will read exposure data stored in the data lake and downstream joins will connect exposures with user actions. Athena configuration requires data sources, exposure queries, anonymous ID support, and IAM read access to specific tables. Outstanding work includes iOS, web, experiment, and Athena setup, with support available Monday afternoon, Tuesday morning, and asynchronously through Slack. Namespace best-practice guidance was also requested.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, A/B experimentation, SDK integration, Athena data warehouse, Exposure events, Feature flags
